reason: The native video panel lacks explicit adoption and manual editing/export independent of the GPU execution queue. Existing manual output nodes alone cannot provide busy-time export.

proposed_resolution.owner: video_workbench CPU projection over ManualDraftOwner; successful analysis snapshot remains VideoRequestOwner-owned

actions.preview: Exactly action and fields; fields are the seven existing ManualDraft string inputs, each at most 20000 Unicode characters. Return canonical manual V0Result and TXT without model, GPU, queue, filesystem or clipboard side effects.
actions.adopt: Exactly action and run_token. Accept only the current succeeded uncancelled owner run. Return V0Result containing the original raw, PromptSpec, source/frame manifest and deterministic four-output mapping; absent language remains absent.

proposed_resolution.response: Object with result (existing lvw.v0.result/1) and txt; errors retain existing error envelope/codes
proposed_resolution.limits: 2 MiB request, eight-second body deadline; literal loopback peer/Host, matching Origin and X-LVW-Control; reject unknown keys/actions, oversized or malformed bodies before projection
proposed_resolution.client: Keep raw/suggestion separate; only explicit adoption may replace draft. Require second click when draft is nonempty and reject in-flight responses if draft revision or run changed. CPU preview validates edited outputs. Export JSON combines the adopted immutable source snapshot with validated draft and model_adopted/edited origin; this is a user export, not a trusted execution receipt. No localStorage/database or automatic adoption.
